en.headline: CENTRESTAGE fashion fair opens today at the Convention Centre
en.dek: About 270 brands from 24 countries and regions are taking part in the four-day event, which features more than 30 fashion shows and is free for trade and public visitors aged 18 or above.
body: CENTRESTAGE, organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, opens today at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre and runs until Saturday.

The fair brings together around 270 designer brands from 24 countries and regions under thematic zones including Craftsmanship, Contemporary, Urban, Athleisure, Circular Fashion and Accessories. More than 30 fashion shows are scheduled, with the opening CENTRESTAGE ELITES presentation spotlighting KIT WAN STUDIOS.
Admission is free for trade visitors and members of the public aged 18 or above, subject to registration. Opening hours are 10am to 7pm from Wednesday to Friday and 10am to 6pm on Saturday.

zh.headline: 香港國際時尚匯展今日於會展開幕
zh.dek: 約270個品牌來自24個國家及地區參與為期四天的展覽，設逾30場時裝表演，18歲或以上業內及公眾人士免費入場。
body: 由香港貿易發展局主辦的香港國際時尚匯展今日於香港會議展覽中心開幕，展期至周六。
展覽匯聚約270個來自24個國家及地區的設計師品牌，設有工藝、當代、都市、運動休閒、循環時尚及配飾等主題展區，並安排逾30場時裝表演，開幕夜聚焦KIT WAN STUDIOS。
18歲或以上業內人士及公眾可免費入場，惟須預先登記。開放時間為周三至五上午10時至下午7時，周六上午10時至下午6時。
